verdict.rationale: Running custom code as a workflow step is a fair question for a workflow automation platform like Make, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents a JavaScript or Python code module inside a scenario. The built-in data-transformation functions and the custom-apps components (modules, RPCs) are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not an in-workflow code step, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drop into real code (JavaScript or Python) as a step inside a workflow
